content:
nina: Noticed the rate-limit banner that shows when customers hit per-minute quotas. Current copy: `Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.` It's vague and doesn't surface retry timing. Need copy + a11y adjustments.
tom: Totally — users ask in support where to wait and whether retries will succeed. We should surface the `Retry-After` time if backend provides it, or a fallback like 'a few seconds'. Also change button labels from `OK` to `Retry` (primary) and `Contact support` (secondary).
olga: Backend can send `Retry-After` in seconds. When present we can format: "Please wait 12s before retrying." If not present we can show approximations. Also server already returns X-Rate-Limit-Limit and X-Rate-Limit-Remaining headers for some endpoints.
rachel: From support: users often panic when they hit limits during demos. Tone should be calm and prescriptive. Short suggested copy: "You're sending requests too quickly. Wait {time} then try again, or contact support if this happens often." Add a link to quota docs for self-serve upgrades.
design-bot: [automated] Current banner: `Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.` severity=warning code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED retention=6s
tom: Copy variants: 
1) Minimal: "Rate limit reached. Wait {time} and try again."
2) Friendly: "You're sending requests too fast. Please wait {time} to retry, or upgrade your plan for higher limits."
3) Actionable: "You've reached the rate limit for this endpoint. Wait {time} to retry, or contact support to increase your quota. View quota details."
nina: I like variant 3 but shorten it for the banner. Maybe show the short line and an expand chevron for details. Eg short: "Rate limit reached — please wait 12s to retry." Expand: fuller text + links.
olga: Accessibility: banner should be aria-live="polite" for throttles (not urgent), except when blocking interactive flows where aria-live="assertive" is more appropriate. Also ensure the `Retry` button is focusable and keyboard-first.
rachel: Add SR text for screen readers: "Rate limit reached. Retry After 12 seconds. Press Retry to try again." Avoid punctuation that causes pauses.
tom: Microcopy for buttons: primary="Retry now" (or "Retry in 12s" but dynamic labels can be surprising) secondary="Contact support" tertiary link="Quota details". For tiny screens, maybe only show primary + link.
olga: Suggest including a small progress countdown in the banner (e.g., "Retry in 12s") so users see when they can retry. Implementation: frontend reads `Retry-After` and counts down.
design-bot: [automated] Suggested retention: if a countdown exists, keep banner until count reaches 0 + 2s.
nina: Edge case: if customer has high concurrency and retries automatically, we should avoid spamming them with banners. Maybe only show banner once per session or per endpoint for 30s.
tom: Tone guidance: neutral, instructive, and low-friction. Avoid words like "blocked" or "denied". Prefer "rate limit" or "requests too fast."
rachel: Also include a small inline suggestion for enterprise users: "Need higher throughput? Contact your account rep." That reduces support noise.
olga: Action items: 1) I'll add `Retry-After` support and X-Rate-Limit headers where missing. 2) Tom, can you prepare the short/expanded copy + a11y SR strings? 3) Nina, can you add the telemetry event when users click Retry/Contact?
nina: Yep, I'll file the telemetry ticket. Tom please add a mockup with the countdown for the PR.
tom: Will do, will include both expanded and compact variants. Thanks!
